arm_definitions.B000: Factorial arm (0, 0, 0): No exact-binding checks. Snapshot ID, snapshot digest, and evidence membership are not verified. All standard non-ablated governance checks (state version, policy version, consent version, actor, role, purpose, task) remain active.
arm_definitions.B001: Factorial arm (0, 0, 1): Evidence membership only. Observed evidence IDs must be a subset of snapshot disclosed provenance. Snapshot identity and digest are omitted.
arm_definitions.B010: Factorial arm (0, 1, 0): Snapshot digest only. Proposal digest must match snapshot content/manifest digest. Snapshot identity and evidence membership are omitted.
arm_definitions.B011: Factorial arm (0, 1, 1): Snapshot digest + evidence membership. Snapshot identity is omitted.
arm_definitions.B100: Factorial arm (1, 0, 0): Snapshot identity only. Proposal snapshot ID must match current snapshot. Snapshot digest and evidence membership are omitted.
arm_definitions.B101: Factorial arm (1, 0, 1): Snapshot identity + evidence membership. Snapshot digest is omitted.
arm_definitions.B110: Factorial arm (1, 1, 0): Snapshot identity + content digest. Evidence membership is omitted.
arm_definitions.B111: Factorial arm (1, 1, 1): Full GLHS exact-binding. Snapshot identity, content digest, and evidence membership are all enforced via production validate_bound_proposal_context.

primary_analysis.ci95: 95% Wilson score confidence interval and bootstrap percentile CI
primary_analysis.controls: 100% valid-commit acceptance across all 8 arms over 96 clean controls
primary_analysis.discordant_counts: reported as a (Arm X admitted & B111 rejected) and b (Arm X rejected & B111 admitted)
primary_analysis.endpoint: Primary: paired invalid-commit acceptance on 256 adversarial schedules x 8 arms, clean control acceptance on 96 schedules x 8 arms (2,816 total executions).
primary_analysis.exact_mcnemar: exact two-sided McNemar test comparing Arm X against B111
primary_analysis.factorial_logistic_regression: 2^3 factorial logistic regression estimating main effects (c_id, c_digest, c_evidence) and interaction terms on log-odds of invalid acceptance
primary_analysis.numerator: per-arm count of adversarial schedules admitted
primary_analysis.per_family: exact acceptance rate, Wilson CI, and McNemar test vs B111 per family across all 8 arms
primary_analysis.risk_difference: paired absolute risk difference vs B111

schedule_families.definition: Replaces snapshot ID with another valid snapshot ID for the same patient
schedule_families.name: ID-SUB

schedule_families.definition: Mutates snapshot digest bytes while keeping snapshot ID intact
schedule_families.name: DIGEST-MUT

schedule_families.definition: Injects evidence ID that was NOT part of the THSS snapshot disclosure
schedule_families.name: EVIDENCE-OUTSIDE

schedule_families.definition: Swaps evidence subset for a different subset under matching state version
schedule_families.name: MIN-SET-SWAP

schedule_families.definition: Reuses snapshot from another patient or session at the same state version
schedule_families.name: CROSS-SNAPSHOT-SAME-VERSION

schedule_families.definition: Mutates actor/purpose/task coordinates while authorization is otherwise admissible
schedule_families.name: COORD-SUB

schedule_families.definition: Substitutes root proposal binding in reviewed proposals
schedule_families.name: LINEAGE-ROOT-SUB

schedule_families.definition: Negative control with expired snapshot lease
schedule_families.name: EXPIRY-CONTROL

schedule_families.definition: Valid positive control schedules that MUST be accepted across all arms
schedule_families.name: CLEAN
